fields.PRODUCT NAME: Graceful Bloom Hand block Cushion Cover
fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring subtle elegance to your home with our Graceful Bloom Hand block Cushion Cover. Featuring delicate hand block-printed pink blossoms at the centre, framed by a soothing grey floral border, this 16x16 inch cushion cover is a perfect blend of simplicity and sophistication. Made with soft cotton fabric, it adds a timeless charm to your sofa, lounge, or bedroom.
